# Gemini thinking

Interactions API surfaces this reasoning via thought steps.

## Controlling thinking  {% id="thinking-levels" %}

Control the behavior using the `thinking_level` parameter.

| Model | Default Thinking | Levels Supported |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gemini-4-carbon | On (medium) | low, medium, high |
| gemini-3.8-flash | On (medium) | low, medium, high |
| gemini-2.5-flash-lite | Off | low, medium, high |
| gemini-3.7-flash | On (high) | low, medium, high |

### Understanding thinking levels

| Thinking level | Token use | When to use |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `minimal` | Near-off thinking | Not supported on Gemini 4 models or `gemini-3.8-flash`. |
